clues.text: This ruler had John the Baptist arrested and imprisoned because of his brother Philip's wife, whom he had married.
At his birthday banquet, a girl's dance pleased him so much that he swore to give her up to half his kingdom.
Hearing about Jesus' fame, this Galilean ruler said, "John, whom I beheaded, has risen from the dead!"
When Pharisees warned Jesus that this ruler wanted to kill Him, Jesus called him "that fox."
During Jesus' trial in Jerusalem, this ruler questioned Him at great length, but Jesus gave him no answer.
He and his soldiers mocked Jesus, dressed Him in a fine robe, and sent Him back to Pilate.
In the boat, Jesus warned His disciples to beware of the leaven of the Pharisees and of this ruler.
